headline: 10 Michigan deals, $86.3M raised — led by ENDRA Life Sciences Inc.

top_deals.summary: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with ASP Isotopes Inc.; filing cites a figure of ~$200M.
Clarkston QV Fund, LP, a Bloomfield Hills-based investment fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $80.6M sold to 57 investors. (Amended filing.)
Chuck Waste, Inc, a Walker-based technology company, filed a $7M equity offering under Rule 506(b); $834K sold to 4 investors.
Boch Investment Fund, LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based private equity fund, disclosed a $6M raise; $0 sold.
Dart Financial Corp, a Mason-based commercial banking company, filed an indefinite-size equity offering under Rule 504; $3.6M sold to 403 investors. (Amended filing.)

new_funds.summary: Clarkston QV Fund, LP, a Bloomfield Hills-based investment fund, disclosed an open-ended (indefinite) raise; $80.6M sold to 57 investors. (Amended filing.)
Boch Investment Fund, LLC, a Bloomfield Hills-based private equity fund, disclosed a $6M raise; $0 sold.

notable_ma.summary: ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA) disclosed a definitive merger/acquisition agreement with ASP Isotopes Inc.; filing cites a figure of ~$200M.
Gentherm Inc (THRM) reported completing an acquisition or disposition of assets.

material_agreements.summary: Sun Communities Inc (SUI) entered into a material definitive agreement.
Universal Logistics Holdings, Inc. (ULH) entered into a material definitive agreement (credit facility).

talking_points.text: Michigan issuers reported $86.3M sold across 6 Form D filings this week, up 31% vs. the prior 4-week average. The largest was Chuck Waste, Inc (Walker, Other Technology) targeting $7M. Good question to ask: are founders in technology favoring equity rounds over venture debt right now?

ENDRA Life Sciences Inc. (NDRA) disclosed a deal with ASP Isotopes Inc.. It was one of 2 M&A filings this week. Use it to ask how buyers are valuing Michigan health care & life sciences assets and whether consolidation is accelerating.

2 Michigan-based pooled funds filed Form Ds, reporting $80.6M raised so far — led by Clarkston QV Fund, LP (Other Investment Fund). A natural opener: what are LPs asking Michigan sponsors for in today's fundraising market?
